newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: U.S. fighter jets make emergency stop in Manila.
newsitem.headline: U.S. fighter jets make emergency stop in Manila.

text.p: Two U.S. airforce fighter jets and a tanker plane made an emergency landing at Manila's international airport on Saturday after one of the jets suffered a technical problem, U.S. pilot Lt. Col. Richard Kessel said.
Kessel said the left engine of his plane malfunctioned forcing him to request an emergency landing. No one was hurt.
They were on their way to Townsville, Australia, from Kadena airforce base in Japan. He declined to give information about their mission.
Kessel has asked the U.S. embassy in Manila for assistance in organising repairs.
The emergency landing did not affect international and domestic commercial flight schedules, an airport official said.
